text: According to the neuroscience section, what is the main objection to FORCE as a biological learning rule for motor cortex?
choices: It must modify recurrent synapses, which biological neurons cannot do
It converges far too slowly to match real animal motor learning
It predicts fixed-point dynamics, contradicting M1's observed rotational dynamics
It requires a global, moment-by-moment supervised error signal e(t) that has no identified source in M1
explanation: The standard objection is that RLS needs the target output at every millisecond (a global supervised error) with no known M1 substrate. Standard FORCE does NOT modify recurrent weights; it converges quickly (real learning is slower); and it actually REPRODUCES M1 rotational dynamics rather than contradicting them.
